Car stuck right now, and the customer reports that a repair we did (RO-187778) keeps failing and demands a manager. Per the tie-break, this goes to needs_human. Roadside is a secondary type, and the escalation reason is customer_request (the manager demand), though safety also applies because the customer is stranded. A single reason is required, so I chose customer_request, as the manager demand plus the complaint is what drives the routing to needs_human.
